name: Chase late payments
tagline: Each morning, I draft and send polite reminders for every overdue invoice — one email per customer.
description: I check QuickBooks daily for overdue invoices, group them by customer so nobody gets multiple emails, escalate tone with age (friendly → firm → final notice), and check that I haven't already chased them recently. I'll ask before sending anything over $5,000 or any final-notice email.

approvals.reason: Final-notice or large-balance reminder — please review before sending

test_cases.name: no overdue invoices
test_cases.rubric: The agent calls quickbooks_search_invoices with overdue=true. When it gets back zero results (the test fixture should arrange this), it ends with 'No overdue invoices today.' and does NOT call gmail_send.

test_cases.name: single tier-1 reminder
test_cases.rubric: When one customer has one invoice that's 5 days overdue for $1,200, the agent fetches the customer, drafts a friendly (T1) reminder addressed to them by name, mentions the invoice number and amount, and sends it via gmail_send (under $5,000, no approval gate). The summary reports 1 customer chased.

test_cases.name: consolidates multiple invoices for one customer
test_cases.rubric: When a customer has three overdue invoices, the agent sends ONE email listing all three (with numbers, due dates, and amounts) — not three separate emails. The summary should reflect 1 email sent for 3 invoices.

test_cases.name: skips already-chased customer
test_cases.rubric: When gmail_search returns a recent reminder thread to that customer, the agent does NOT send another email. The summary mentions the skip.

test_cases.name: T3 final notice requires approval
test_cases.rubric: When the oldest overdue invoice is 60+ days late, the agent drafts a T3 final-notice email. The platform's approval guardrail trips before gmail_send fires (run pauses with status awaiting_approval). It is acceptable that the agent never reaches the summary on this run — that's the gate doing its job.

test_cases.name: missing customer email
test_cases.rubric: When quickbooks_get_customer returns a customer with no PrimaryEmailAddr, the agent does NOT call gmail_send (no fabricated email). It lists the customer in its summary with the missing-email anomaly noted.
